propositions: When an LLM call is blocked by a content policy (Bedrock Guardrail or Anthropic refusal), the operator message incorrectly reports 'too large / malformed' instead of naming the guardrail block.
The resolution_class CHANGE_INPUT is correct (non-retryable) and should not be reclassified, only the message text should be refined.
message_for() must accept an optional finish_reason parameter and branch on finish_reason='content_filter' with resolution_class=CHANGE_INPUT to return a distinct guardrail-aware message.
finish_reason is available on LLMOutcome.diagnostic and persisted coverage diagnostic and must be threaded through three call sites.
Genuine CHANGE_INPUT cases (HTTP 413, context-length limits) must retain the existing generic message to avoid over-broadening the fix.
